access.notes: Open-source DFT code capable of LSDA, LSDA+U, spin-orbit coupling, and linear-response Hubbard U calculation. Install via conda/pip or compile.
The hexagonal Mn5Si3-type structure (space group P6_3/mcm), initial lattice parameters, and atomic coordinates for La5Ge3, Ce5Ge3, Pr5Ge3, and Nd5Ge3 are provided in the task instruction.
